title: Coherence of canonical higher-image transitions over a fixed scheme
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring, k:W→S a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], G a sheaf of Λ-modules on W_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and q∈ℤ. For φ:U→V in Over W let t(φ):R^q(V→S)_*V^*G→R^q(U→S)_*U^*G be the canonical transition of [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], using inverse and direct image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then t(id_U)=id, and t(φ≫ψ)=t(ψ)≫t(φ) for every composable φ:U→V and ψ:V→Z.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, canonical transitions; derived inverse-image adjunction composition and its triangle identities

proof.text: Expand the derived transition as the adjoint of a^* of the counit, transported along the inverse-image composition isomorphism. For an identity morphism the composition comparison is the identity comparison; the adjunction triangle identity reduces the transition to the identity.

For two composable arrows expand the unit for their composite using the composite adjunction. By naturality move the intervening unit past the counit. Cancel that unit-counit pair by the triangle identity. Associativity of the inverse-image composition comparisons makes the factors left exactly the adjoint of the counit for the composite. The equalities of structure maps in Over W only contribute proof-irrelevant equality transports.

Apply degree-q homology. Its map preserves identities and composition. Naturality of the inverse-image comparison with singleFunctor moves the degree-zero identification through the composite. The ordinary inverse-image associativity comparison identifies φ^*ψ^*Z^*G with U^*G in the same way as the one-step arrow, giving the stated coherence.

lean.statement: theorem higher_image_over_transition_coherence (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S) (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ) : (∀ U : Over W, higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q (𝟙 U) = 𝟙 _) ∧ (∀ {U V Z : Over W} (φ : U ⟶ V) (ψ : V ⟶ Z), higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q (φ ≫ ψ) = higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q ψ ≫ higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q φ)
